semanticHighlighting.title: Dart semantic highlighting
semanticHighlighting.description: Provide Dart overlay semantic highlighting for doc-comment symbol links and pubspec.yaml alongside Dart LSP.

highlightFunctionCalls.title: Highlight Dart function & method calls
highlightFunctionCalls.description: Highlight function/method declarations and calls (including generic calls like readList<String>(...)) alongside Dart LSP tokens.

formatOnSave.title: Format Dart files on save
formatOnSave.description: Run `dart format` when saving a `.dart` file.

pubspecDiagnostics.title: Validate pubspec.yaml
pubspecDiagnostics.description: Highlight duplicate dependencies, invalid package names, and missing local path dependencies while editing.

showCodeLenses.title: Show Dart Code Lenses
showCodeLenses.description: Display inline Pub Get / Upgrade / Outdated lenses in pubspec.yaml and Run/Test lenses in Dart files.

showTestGutterActions.title: Show main() and test() gutter run buttons
showTestGutterActions.description: Display runnable gutter icons next to `main()`, `test()`, and `group()` declarations.
